Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie
Company Overview: 
 At EPCM 10 , we dedicate our expertise to delivering superior project management services tailored to our clients' needs. With over fifteen years of experience, we have developed an effective management methodology that ensures timely and cost-effective project completion. Our client-oriented approach establishes us as a strong liaison among clients, suppliers, contractors, professional consultants, and local authorities. We pride ourselves on solving daily engineering challenges and focusing on the successful completion of our projects on time, with quality and within budget. 
 Position Overview: 
 We are looking for an IT & Cybersecurity Engineer to join our team and take responsibility for both the day-to-day IT needs of EPCM 10 and the operational implementation of our cybersecurity framework.
 This is an office-based role split approximately 50-50 between IT and Cybersecurity. The role combines hands-on technical work (e.g. setting up workstations, software, networks and troubleshooting) with responsibility for maintaining and continuously improving EPCM 10 ’s cybersecurity processes, policies and awareness programs.
 The ideal candidate is practical, curious and solution-oriented, comfortable working directly with colleagues and technology, and able to translate cybersecurity requirements into simple, practical actions.
 Responsibilities: 
 IT – Hardware, Software & Infrastructure 
 · Set up, configure and maintain laptops, workstations, printers, mobile devices and other IT equipment.
 · Install and maintain software and applications according to each employee’s role and project requirements.
 · Provide day-to-day technical support and troubleshoot hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and connectivity issues.
 · Support the configuration and maintenance of the internal office network, Wi-Fi, VPN and other IT infrastructure.
 · Manage IT assets, software licenses and lifecycle equipment.
 · Coordinate technical issues and interventions with the external IT service provider.
 · Ensure workstations and IT equipment follow EPCM 10 ’s security and configuration requirements.
 Cybersecurity 
 · Implement and maintain EPCM 10 ’s Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS), policies, procedures, standards and work instructions.
 · Maintain cybersecurity registers, records and evidence required for NIS2 compliance.
 · Support cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain the Cybersecurity Risk Register.
 · Coordinate the handling, investigation and documentation of cybersecurity incidents together with the external IT provider.
 · Follow up vulnerabilities, security updates, patching and remediation actions.
 · Manage and periodically review user access rights.
 · Support backup, recovery and business continuity activities and tests.
 · Support cybersecurity assessments of suppliers and third parties.
 · Deliver cybersecurity awareness sessions and practical training for employees.
 · Organize and support phishing simulations and knowledge assessments.
 · Promote a strong, practical cybersecurity culture across EPCM 10 .
 What we are looking for: 
 We are looking for a person with a solid practical IT background and a genuine interest in cybersecurity .
 · Degree in Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 · Previous experience in IT support, IT administration, infrastructure or a similar technical role.
 · Good knowledge of Windows and Microsoft 365 environments.
 · Good understanding of networking basics: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, servers, firewalls.
 · Familiarity with endpoint security, patch management, MFA, backups and access control.
 · Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts, incident management and risk management.
 · Good English communication skills. 
 · Ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues.
 · Strong troubleshooting, organizational and problem-solving skills.
 · Ability to work independently, take ownership and know when to escalate.
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with Microsoft Defender, SharePoint, EDR/XDR, SIEM or vulnerability-management platforms, as well as knowledge of NIS2 requirements and/ or ISO/IEC 27001. 
 Personal profile: 
 We would particularly value someone who is hands-on, reliable, curious and proactive , someone who enjoys fixing a problem when it happens, but is even more interested in understanding why it happened and how to prevent it from happening again.
